# Retrieval fixture: synthetic vendor interview (todo 12 benchmark corpus)
Moderator: How did the documentation treat you during setup?
P1 Dana: The documentation was stale and the screenshots were outdated, so I guessed at half the steps.
Moderator: When you hit that wall, what did support do?
P2 Ben: Support answered within the hour and the ticket queue never backed up, so I kept moving.
Moderator: Did the migration tooling save you time?
P1 Dana: The migration scripts moved our old records overnight; the data import ran clean.
Moderator: How painful was the password reset flow?
P2 Ben: The password reset email arrived late twice and locked me out of login.
Moderator: What do you think about the pricing model?
P1 Dana: Pricing tiers are clear and there were no hidden fees at checkout.
Moderator: How confident are you in our security posture?
P2 Ben: The SOC 2 report and the yearly penetration test convinced our IT team.
Moderator: Has reliability been an issue?
P1 Dana: One hour of downtime in May; the status page kept us informed the whole time.
Moderator: Do you need to get data out of the system?
P2 Ben: The CSV export covers everything and the backup download runs weekly.
Moderator: How is the single sign-on rollout going?
P1 Dana: SAML was easy to wire and single sign-on works for the whole staff.
Moderator: Are people using the mobile app?
P2 Ben: The iOS app is smooth and offline sync keeps field notes current.
Moderator: What about the reporting dashboards?
P1 Dana: Custom reports take minutes and the charts render fast.
Moderator: Have you hit the API rate limits?
P2 Ben: Throttling kicked in once; the requests per minute cap is documented now.
Moderator: How do you manage team permissions?
P1 Dana: Admin roles are granular and access control finally makes sense.
Moderator: Did the training materials help the team?
P2 Ben: The video tutorials got new hires going; webinars cover the deep dives.
Moderator: Are custom fields working for your workflow?
P1 Dana: Metadata tags map to our process and the form builder is flexible.
Moderator: What do you think of the templates?
P2 Ben: Project templates save setup time and the preset layouts look professional.
Moderator: Have you integrated webhooks yet?
P1 Dana: Event callbacks fire instantly and the HTTP notifications feed our bot.
Moderator: How does the SLA hold up in practice?
P2 Ben: The uptime commitment is real; we once received service credits without asking.
Moderator: Any friction with billing?
P1 Dana: The monthly invoice is itemized and payment methods include bank transfer.
Moderator: Do you ever work without connectivity?
P2 Ben: Airplane mode works; the local cache catches edits and syncs later.
Moderator: How well does search serve you?
P1 Dana: Full-text search is instant and the filters narrow results precisely.
Moderator: Is localization important for your offices?
P2 Ben: Language packs shipped for our Berlin team and translations read naturally.
Moderator: How accessible does the UI feel?
P1 Dana: The screen reader support is solid and keyboard shortcuts cover every action.
Moderator: Do you feel heard on the roadmap?
P2 Ben: The feature requests board is active and our votes changed the order twice.
Moderator: How was the first-run experience overall?
P1 Dana: The setup wizard walked me through everything and the checklist kept me on track.
Moderator: Why did you switch vendors, honestly?
P2 Ben: The previous vendor stalled on fixes; switching cost was lower than staying stuck.
